# محبة الحكمة | Mahabat Lhikma

> منصة تعليمية تحوّل الفلسفة إلى تجربة تفاعلية ممتعة

## About

Mahabat Lhikma (محبة الحكمة) is an Arabic educational platform that transforms philosophy into an engaging interactive experience. It combines AI-powered teaching tools, interactive games, media resources, and structured learning paths for philosophy educators and students.

## Creator

Mohamed Elyousfi — philosophy educator and AI integration specialist.

## Sections

- **Homepage** (https://mahabatlhikma.pages.dev/): Platform overview with all interactive sections.
- **Philomedia** (https://mahabatlhikma.pages.dev/philomedia): Curated philosophical media library — videos, podcasts, and visual content.
- **AI Prompts** (https://mahabatlhikma.pages.dev/prompts): Ready-to-use prompts that turn any AI model into a philosophy tutor or debate coach.
- **Skills** (https://mahabatlhikma.pages.dev/skills): Claude-ready educational skills for lesson building, research, and interactive learning.
- **Games** (https://mahabatlhikma.pages.dev/games): Educational games — philosophy is played, not just memorized.
- **NotebookLM Guide** (https://mahabatlhikma.pages.dev/notebooklm): Practical guide for teachers using NotebookLM, Gemini, and ChatGPT in philosophy lessons.
- **AI Booklet** (https://mahabatlhikma.pages.dev/booklet): Concise AI guide for philosophy teachers — the three rules, effective prompting, and skills.
- **Feedback** (https://mahabatlhikma.pages.dev/feedback): Share your feedback and help improve the platform.

## Language

Arabic (ar)
